Our story 25-year system and product warranty to every Accredited Briticom™ Partner Become a Partner We are always interested to work with installation companies that are proactive and keen to work with us to promote Briticom™ products and solutions. Work with Briticom™ Product Ranges Fibre Optic Briticom™ is a supplier of a wide array of fibre optic cable. Available in many specifications, for both indoor and outdoor use. See more Copper Structured Cabling Briticom™ offers top quality, full AWG copper cabling, as well as a wide range of components and accessories designed and manufactured to meet and exceed ISO, and TIA standards. See more Cabinets & Racks Briticom™ cabinets and racks are enclosures used to house, protect and enable the management or the connection of cables and cable ends. See more Data Centre Solutions Briticom™ offers all the required systems, assemblies and components for a complete data centre solution.
